rules.name: long_only
rules.message: Long only: entries are buys, exits are sells, no shorts.

rules.name: cash_only
rules.message: Cash only: cost + reserved cash must not exceed the cash balance; never use 2x buying power.

rules.name: starter_size
rules.message: Starter 3.5% of equity; adds only to winners.

rules.name: max_new_per_cycle
rules.message: At most 3 new positions per cycle.

rules.name: single_stock_cap
rules.message: Max 35% of equity per stock (competition hard cap 40%).

rules.name: protective_stop
rules.message: Stop 6-10% below entry, below pivot, submitted as a real order.

rules.name: no_averaging_down
rules.message: Never add to a losing position.

rules.name: flatten_before_holiday
rules.message: Flat before Thanksgiving; no new entries from 25 Nov.

rules.name: event_blackout
rules.message: No new entries in a name around a scheduled earnings print.

rules.name: index_regime
rules.message: No new buys while the S&P 500 is in a correction (below a falling 50DMA).

rules.name: opening_blackout
rules.message: No new buys in the first 15 minutes of the regular session.

rules.name: liquidity_floor
rules.message: Average daily dollar volume must exceed US$100M.
